caveats:
Border names are mostly from the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine, the State Customs Service of Ukraine, Wikipedia, and Ukraine 2024 COD-AB.

The types (Road, Pedestrian, and River) and statuses (Operational and Closed) of border crossings are based on the information from the interactive web map by the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine and the State Customs Service of Ukraine's web portal.
dataset_source: Government of Ukraine and open sources
name: ukraine-border-crossings
notes: This dataset includes the names, types, statuses, and coordinates of international border crossings of Ukraine with Belarus, Hungary, Moldova, Poland, Romania, Russian Federation and Slovakia. The names of the border crossings are in English and Ukrainian.
